title: EmbedGym: Letting Coding Agents Develop and Debug Embedded Firmware Without Physical Hardware
abstract: arXiv:2611.21845v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Modern coding agents perform well on general software benchmarks because they can run code and unit tests in a closed loop. Embedded firmware development, however, breaks this loop: a program that compiles can still fail on real hardware due to pin polarity, bus protocol, timing, or networking bugs that an agent at a text terminal cannot observe. Existing embedded coding agents either skip hardware execution, drive GPIO-only simulators with multi-second delays, or test on physical boards in a static environment. In this paper, we present EmbedGym, an interactive virtual hardware environment that lets coding agents develop and debug embedded firmware without physical hardware. EmbedGym uses instruction-level microcontroller unit (MCU) emulators to execute the same binary that would be flashed onto a physical board, connects them to 41 peripheral models, an analog circuit simulator, and virtual WiFi/Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) endpoints,

translated_title: EmbedGym：让编码代理无需物理硬件即可开发和调试嵌入式固件
translated_abstract: 现代编码代理在通用软件基准测试中表现出色，因为它们可以在闭环中运行代码和单元测试。然而，嵌入式固件开发打破了这一循环：一个能够编译的程序在真实硬件上仍可能因引脚极性、总线协议、时序或网络问题而失败，而这些问题对于处于文本终端的代理来说是无法观察到的。现有的嵌入式编码代理要么跳过硬件执行，要么使用具有数秒延迟的仅支持GPIO的模拟器，要么在静态环境中测试物理板卡。在本文中，我们提出了EmbedGym，这是一个交互式虚拟硬件环境，使编码代理能够在没有物理硬件的情况下开发和调试嵌入式固件。EmbedGym使用指令级微控制器（MCU）仿真器来执行与烧录到物理板上相同的二进制文件，并将其连接到41个外设模型、一个模拟电路仿真器以及虚拟WiFi/低功耗蓝牙（BLE）端点。
tldr: EmbedGym是一个交互式虚拟硬件环境，通过指令级MCU仿真器结合41个外设模型、模拟电路仿真器及虚拟WiFi/BLE端点，让编码代理无需物理硬件即可开发和调试嵌入式固件。
en_tdlr: EmbedGym is an interactive virtual hardware environment that enables coding agents to develop and debug embedded firmware without physical hardware, by running instruction-level MCU emulators executing the same binary as the physical board, connected to 41 peripheral models, an analog circuit simulator, and virtual WiFi/BLE endpoints.
